display.purpose: Hero headings over full-width parallax imagery only. Alfa Slab One, uppercase, wide tracking. Never at content-section level.

subheading.purpose: Supporting text directly beneath display headings in the banner layer. Same typeface, smaller scale.

headline.purpose: First h1 of a content page, below the banner. Rubik Extra Bold.

title.purpose: H2 section headings within content. Named sections like 'Building a Legacy'.

label.purpose: Navigation links, captions, stat labels, UI affordance text.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state for buttons, nav links, social icons. Confirms interactivity. Never at rest.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Nav dropdown menus. Two-layer shadow grounds the floating layer.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Search results panel, large floating surfaces.

shadows.name: navbar-scroll
shadows.purpose: Floating navbar after scroll. Applied with green backdrop-filter blur.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for nav transitions and mobile menu slide.

motion.name: ease-out-snappy
motion.purpose: Interactive tilt hover scale. Feels immediate and confident.

motion.name: fade-in-section
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section reveals. translateY(40px) → 0. Must be suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: nav-hover
motion.purpose: Nav link hover color and background transitions.

motion.name: mobile-menu-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile fullscreen nav slide in from right.

motion.name: stagger-base-delay
motion.purpose: Mobile nav link staggered entrance. Each nth-child adds 0.05s delay.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile layout adjustments: banner height, main padding, banner strip.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop nav: hamburger hidden, inline nav shown, dropdown hover enabled.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default CTA. Dark green at rest, Coyle Green on hover, slight scale lift. Warm and tactile.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #064121; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A8A3F; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #53f55c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: White background, dark green text. Used for the Incoming Students / New Crew CTA on dark navbar surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; color: #064121; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0A8A3F; color: #ffffff; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #53f55c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Floating navbar link. Transparent at rest, Coyle Green on hover/active, 16px pill radius.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #0A8A3F; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav-link.ds-nav-link--active { background: #0A8A3F; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #53f55c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Ghost search field used inside the floating navbar. Transparent background, white border, icon left-aligned.
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 20px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size: 1.1rem; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; width: 100%; padding: 8px 20px 8px 50px; font-size: 1.1rem; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); } .ds-search-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,1); }

components.name: Content Card / Image Block
components.description: Photo + text alternating layout blocks. Image has rounded corners and interactive tilt on hover.

components.css: .ds-content-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; max-width: 64rem; margin: 0 auto; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-content-card { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; } } .ds-content-card__img { border-radius: 16px; width: 100%; max-width: 36rem; object-fit: cover; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 0.25s ease-out; } .ds-content-card__img:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-content-card__title { font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #064121; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-content-card__text { font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65; color: #444444; max-width: 65ch; }

narrative.overview:
Coyle Hall's visual system carries the weight of a place that has been lived in and loved. This isn't a new building introducing itself — it's a community with 70 years of history moving into a new home. The design conveys permanence without stiffness, pride without performance. Every surface should feel like something earned rather than branded.

The palette is deep and committed: Coyle green dominates. The typography pairs a slab display face — wide, uppercase, institutional — with the friendly utility of Rubik at every other size. Motion is purposeful: parallax banners, staggered nav entrances, and fade-in sections that build toward the content rather than distracting from it. Interactions feel warm and tactile — a button press feels like a handshake, not a tap on glass.

This system explicitly rejects the generic university web template aesthetic: interchangeable layouts, corporate neutrals, stock imagery in card grids. It also rejects the social-media-ified hall site that looks like a feed. Coyle Hall has a specific identity. The site should be unmistakably this hall.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Coyle green is the dominant surface color, not an accent
Alfa Slab One owns the banner/hero layer; Rubik owns everything else
Rounded pill shapes (16px radius) for all interactive elements
Parallax banners with green tint overlay establish each page's identity
Shadows appear on state (hover, elevation) only — default surface is flat
Wave canvas transitions bridge banner and content layer on inner pages
Dark mode inverts background to black, shifts greens lighter; identity holds in both

rules.name: The Green-Is-The-Brand Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a new accent color unless it is ND Gold or ND Blue in a co-branding context. The system has one accent family: green. Its depth is the identity.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: The body background is white (#ffffff) in light mode and black (#000000) in dark mode. Do not replace with beige, cream, paper, or warm near-whites.

rules.name: The Slab-Only-Over-Images Rule
rules.body: Alfa Slab One appears exclusively in the banner layer — over full-width photography with the green tint overlay. Never use it as a content section heading, card title, or inline heading.

rules.name: The No-Third-Typeface Rule
rules.body: The system uses exactly two typefaces. Do not add a third, even for a 'special section.'

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No element carries a shadow in its default, non-hovered state unless it is a floating layer (dropdown, panel, modal). State triggers shadow; rest earns flatness.

dos: Do use #064121 (Deep Forest Green) as the primary identity surface for navbars, overlays, and dropdown menus.
Do use #0A8A3F (Coyle Green) for hover states, active links, CTA buttons, and interactive indicators.
Do keep Alfa Slab One exclusively for banner/hero headings over full-width imagery with the green tint layer.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on all animations — content must be visible without the transition firing.
Do verify #444 body text on white background passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) before switching to any lighter gray.
Do use border-radius 16px as the universal interactive element radius.
Do let photography and green palette carry warmth — never use beige or cream backgrounds.
donts: Don't build the site to look like a generic ND department page: muted neutrals, interchangeable card grids, corporate spacing.
Don't introduce social-media-style layouts — card feeds, infinite scroll, Instagram-grid composition.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Use solid color; emphasis via weight or size.
Don't add a third typeface. The system has two: Alfa Slab One (banners) and Rubik (everything else).
Don't add a colored side-stripe border to cards, callouts, or list items as a decorative accent.
Don't use ND Gold (#ae9142) or ND Blue (#0c2340) as UI accent colors outside co-branding contexts.
Don't soften the body background to cream, sand, or any warm near-white.
Don't add section eyebrows ('ABOUT', 'PROCESS') as a default scaffold.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, margin, padding) — only transform and opacity.
Don't show shadow at rest on buttons or nav links — shadow is a state response only.
